convention_rule: Among a row of four similar objects, the single green-lit one marks the target by left-to-right position: 1=P1, 2=P2, 3=P3, 4=P4 (ID order, not table order).
basis: History fits: r06 lit 2nd post->P2, r07 lit 1st barn/bale->P1, r08 lit 3rd lamp->P3. r09_A green lantern in leftmost of four boats; r09_B green lantern in leftmost boat (B shows five vessels, slight ambiguity). P1 is non-client-correct (P2 is).
